description: This file defines internal classes and constants for large integer arithmetic used in decimal-to-binary floating point conversions within the Abseil library. It includes a template class BigUnsigned for fixed-width big integers, with methods for arithmetic operations, comparisons, and conversions, as well as related constants and utility functions.

classes.name: BigUnsigned
classes.description: A fixed-width big integer class supporting arithmetic operations needed for decimal-to-binary conversions, with specializations for max_words=4 and max_words=84.

methods.name: Compare
methods.description: Compares two BigUnsigned instances, returning -1, 0, or 1.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Checks equality between two BigUnsigned instances.

methods.name: operator!=
methods.description: Checks inequality between two BigUnsigned instances.

methods.name: operator<
methods.description: Checks if one BigUnsigned is less than another.

methods.name: operator>
methods.description: Checks if one BigUnsigned is greater than another.

methods.name: operator<=
methods.description: Checks if one BigUnsigned is less than or equal to another.

methods.name: operator>=
methods.description: Checks if one BigUnsigned is greater than or equal to another.
